title: Hearing on disability discrimination enforcement trends
summary: The Council's Disabilities and Civil & Human Rights Committees held a joint oversight hearing on how the Commission on Human Rights enforces disability discrimination protections under the city human rights law. The hearing examined complaint trends, with disability the most common basis for discrimination claims in fiscal year 2025, including 662 disability-related inquiries and 131 substantiated claims. It also covered coordination with the Mayor's Office for People with Disabilities and a related bill on service animal access guidance.
